effective.basis: TCG release of OTS Tournament Pack 9 (OP09-EN001), the printing the pinned cards.cdb text matches

changes.historical_text: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned, you can select and activate 1 of these effects:● Destroy Spell or Trap Cards on the field up to the number of "Elemental Hero", "Destiny Hero" and "Evil Hero" monsters you control (not counting this card).● Select and add 1 "Elemental Hero", "Destiny Hero" or "Evil Hero" monster from your Deck to your hand.
changes.modern_text: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can activate 1 of these effects.● Destroy Spells/Traps on the field, up to the number of "HERO" monsters you control, except this card.● Add 1 "HERO" monster from your Deck to your hand.
changes.summary: Wording modernisation only. The Edison-era text (v1, PT03-EN002) counts and searches '"Elemental Hero", "Destiny Hero" and "Evil Hero"' monsters; from v3 (LCGX-EN024) the three are folded into the 'HERO' umbrella, which cannot change either option's reach in period play because every HERO-setcode monster in the Edison-legal pool carries Elemental (0x3008), Destiny (0xc008) or Evil (0x6008) HERO. '(not counting this card)' to 'except this card', 'Select and add 1' to 'Add 1', and the v3/v4/v5 wobble over a redundant 'You can destroy' all preserve the same resolution, which official/c40044918.lua implements as one optional Normal-or-Special-Summon trigger offering the two options.

review.notes: v0 (JUMP-EN012, 2007-04-21) omitted 'Evil Hero' from both options; v1 (PT03-EN002, earliest TCG date 2007-10-13, a European promo) added it. Both precede the Edison snapshot, so the chain starts at v1 and the v0-to-v1 widening is not recorded. Trailing v6 (BLC1-EN003, 2024-02-22) only swaps a period for a semicolon. HERO-umbrella inertness verified against data/pools/edison-2010.json cross-referenced with BabelCDB setcodes: the pool's other 'Hero'-named cards (Hero Kid, Oscillo Hero, Fake Hero, Hero Signal and the rest) carry no HERO setcode and were never eligible under either text.
